overview: Experience the cultural and spiritual wonders of Nepal with Green Sky Travels. This carefully curated 2-3 day itinerary takes you through the historic and sacred landmarks of Kathmandu, including UNESCO World Heritage Sites like Swayambhunath Stupa, Patan Durbar Square, Pashupatinath Temple, and Boudhanath. Enjoy breathtaking sunrise views over the Himalayas from Nagarkot and explore the ancient city of Bhaktapur. With expert guides, comfortable accommodations, and seamless travel arrangements, this tour promises an enriching and unforgettable experience. Book now with Green Sky Travels and immerse yourself in the essence of Nepal.

sections.title: Why Visit Kathmandu?
paragraphs: Kathmandu, the capital of Nepal, is a city steeped in history, culture, and spirituality. Known as the "City of Temples," it boasts a blend of Hindu and Buddhist traditions, reflected in its exquisite palaces, stupas, and courtyards. Whether you seek adventure, cultural immersion, or spiritual enlightenment, Kathmandu offers a unique and fulfilling experience.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu Nepal and Hotel Transfer
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival, we shall welcome you at the airport with your name card and a traditional khada to greet you in Nepali style. Then we will escort you to your hotel. You can take a rest at your hotel or, if you prefer, explore the surroundings on your own. If time and interest allow, you may walk around the local markets and experience the city's atmosphere. In the evening, we will host a pre-trip meeting at your hotel, where you will meet your tour guide. The guide will provide a detailed briefing about the tour and share the plan for the next day. Enjoy your evening in Kathmandu at your leisure.

itinerary.title: Sightseeing of Kathmandu UNESCO World Heritage Sites
description: After a delightful breakfast at the hotel, embark on a full-day sightseeing tour covering Kathmandu’s most significant cultural and historical landmarks:
Swayambhunath Stupa (Monkey Temple): An ancient Buddhist stupa offering panoramic views of Kathmandu Valley.
Patan Durbar Square: It is a historical palace square renowned for its exquisite architecture and traditional craftsmanship.
Pashupatinath Temple A sacred Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, located along the banks of the Bagmati River.
Boudhanath Stupa: One of the largest Buddhist stupas in the world, a major pilgrimage site for Tibetan Buddhists.
After an enriching day of exploration, return to the hotel for an overnight stay in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Nagarkot Sunrise Trip & Explore Bhaktapur then Departure
description: Early in the morning, drive to Nagarkot, a scenic hilltop destination known for its breathtaking sunrise views over the Himalayan range. After enjoying the mesmerizing sunrise, proceed to Bhaktapur Durbar Square, an ancient city filled with centuries-old temples, courtyards, and vibrant local culture.

In the afternoon or evening, depending on your flight schedule, we will transfer you to the airport for your departure, marking the end of your incredible Kathmandu journey. Have a wonderful journey ahead. We look forward to welcome you back in near future for next holiday.

included: Hotel/Resort accommodations with breakfast, twin sharing
Private experienced, certified and helpful tour guide
Private vehicle for all transfers and tours
goodToKnow: Visa Requirements: Most travelers can obtain a visa on arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport in Kathmandu. Ensure your passport is valid for at least six months.
Currency & Payments: The local currency is Nepalese Rupees (NPR). ATMs are available, but carrying some cash is recommended, especially for small purchases.
Weather & Clothing: Kathmandu experiences varied weather. Light clothing is suitable for warmer months, while winter months require warmer layers. Comfortable walking shoes are essential.
Altitude & Health: Kathmandu is at an altitude of approximately 1,400 meters, which is generally safe for most travelers. However, if you have health concerns, consult your doctor before traveling.
Cultural Etiquette: Nepalese culture values modest dress and respectful behavior at religious sites. Always remove your shoes before entering temples and stupas.
Electricity & Connectivity: Nepal uses Type C and Type D electrical sockets. WiFi is available in most hotels and cafes, but having a local SIM card can be useful.
Local Cuisine: Nepal offers a variety of delicious dishes, including Dal Bhat, momos, and traditional Newari food. If you have dietary restrictions, inform your guide in advance.
